shortBio: an M.Sc. Physics student in Quantum Technology at SRMIST. I explore quantum systems through mathematics and computation.
about: I’m pursuing an M.Sc. in Physics with a specialization in Quantum Technology at SRMIST, following a B.Sc. in Physics and an M.Sc. in Mathematics. I’m interested in how mathematical structure shapes physical models: from quantum confinement and differential equations to the geometry of scattering amplitudes. My current work combines literature study, analytical derivations and the development of numerical and symbolic checks.

interests.title: Quantum theory
interests.description: Quantum confinement, atomic systems, light–matter interaction and the assumptions behind their mathematical models.

interests.title: Mathematical physics
interests.description: Differential equations, spectral methods, special functions, positive geometry and the structure of physical theories.

interests.title: Scientific computing
interests.description: Numerical benchmarks, symbolic calculations and reproducible workflows that connect a derivation to a checkable result.
